text_block_list.name: Monologue

I notice her looking at a claw machine<n>filled with
Umamusume plushies.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
One of my classmates said it's really<n>difficult to win
the Cuties from the<n>machines here.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I love a good challenge, though.<n>Let's give it
a try!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
They're not easy to grab... but<n>perhaps that's what
makes it<n>exciting...
